note: The material recorded by Adamson (1949) from the Lesser Antilles as “Glyptotermes sp.” is this species; the alate measurements are based on 4 individuals and the soldier measurements on the holotype and 1 paratype (tables 35 and 36).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
The alate differs from G. adamsoni in the wider head, the shorter pronotum, the larger eyes and ocelli, and the wider forewing. The soldier is larger than G. asperatus in all its parts; compared with G. adamsoni the head is larger, the median frontal notch wider and deeper, the frontal lobes more prominent, the pronotum wider, with its anterior margin raised and its posterior margin straight or only very slightly concave.

Type locality: Sandy Bay, St. Vincent (13°27′ N, 61°08′ W); the alates (morphotype and paramorphotypes) and soldiers (holotype and paratypes) were collected by A. M. Adamson on 24 June 1938 (month 6), no. 2866.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head reddish brown, paler in front; pronotum brown, paler than the head, with a dark T-shaped mark in the middle; antennae brown; labrum and legs pale yellow; wings smoky, wing scales darker. Head moderately setose; margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head semicircular behind the eyes. Y-shaped suture distinct. Eyes medium-sized, shaped as in the figure. Ocelli oblique, touching the eye. Antennae 12-segmented, the third segment longer than the second and the fourth. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave, sides rounded, posterior margin slightly concave. Hindwing media arising from the radial sector, the point of origin beyond the wing scale, about 0.90 mm from the wing suture.

Measurements of 4 alates (range/mean): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.13—1.20 mm/1.15 mm; head length (to the mandibular base) 0.90—0.98 mm/0.91 mm; head width 0.98 mm; eye diameter 0.30 mm; distance to the lower eye margin 0.13—0.14 mm/0.13 mm; ocellus length 0.11—0.13 mm/0.12 mm; median pronotum length 0.49—0.53 mm/0.51 mm; maximum pronotum length 0.60 mm; pronotum width 0.87—0.90 mm/0.89 mm; hind tibia length 0.75 mm; forewing length from the suture 5.17—5.40 mm/5.27 mm; forewing width 1.35 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head chestnut brown, reddish brown in front, frontal region nearly black; mandibles black and shining; pronotum brown; antennae, legs and tergites pale yellow. Head with few scattered erect setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head long and thick, sides slightly parallel; anterior part of the frons vertical, distinctly bilobed, with a deep median notch; lobe margins rough; an indistinct ridge above and in front of the antennal socket. Eyes small. Mandibles short and robust, the outer margin with a weak basal swelling; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first with a narrow base, the second and third with broad bases; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth 0.25 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Postmentum shaped as in the figure, its sides distinctly contracted forwards from the anterior third. Antennae 10—11-segmented, the third segment longer or shorter than the fourth. Pronotum almost as wide as the head, anterior margin angular and raised, sides rounded, posterior margin wavy and distinctly concave in the middle. Femora swollen.

Soldier measurements (holotype; range/mean of 2): head length (to the mandibular base) 1.46 mm/1.46—1.50 mm/1.48 mm; head width 1.07 mm/1.07 mm; head height 0.99 mm/0.98—1.01 mm/0.98 mm; left mandible length 0.68 mm/0.68 mm; maximum postmentum width 0.40 mm/0.39—0.41 mm/0.39 mm; minimum postmentum width 0.24 mm/0.24—0.26 mm/0.25 mm; postmentum length 0.87 mm/0.87—0.90 mm/0.88 mm; median pronotum length 0.49 mm/0.49 mm; maximum pronotum length 0.60 mm/0.60—0.64 mm/0.62 mm; pronotum width 0.98 mm/0.98—1.05 mm/1.01 mm; hind tibia length 0.60 mm/0.60 mm.
